proposed_action: Mass-enroll all platform users into a new data-sharing program with retroactive consent assumed.
raw_reasoning:
Mass-enrolling users into a new data-sharing program with retroactive consent assumed affects users’ personal data and autonomy. Users would not reasonably expect their data-sharing preferences to be changed without being asked first, and retroactive “assumed” consent is typically not a valid substitute for consent. Therefore, user consent is required before proceeding.

Consent required: YES  
Consent type: EXPLICIT  
Confidence: HIGH
